answer: In this PoA design, each identity is verified by a Wesolowski VDF: a beacon-derived challenge requires a continuous chain of modular squarings, with each output needed before the next input. GPUs may run separate chains, but cannot parallelize one chain to reduce its sequential depth; cloning therefore multiplies the same physical delay and signal cost, making mass Sybil identities impractical even in an oasis of hardware.
